groups.defect: Passing the original guests list instead of uniqueGuests to sendAddGuestsEmails misclassifies existing attendees as newly added.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same incorrect argument at the notification call site and propose the same replacement.

groups.defect: Case-sensitive email comparisons allow blacklist bypasses and insertion of casing variants of existing attendees.
groups.rationale: All three report blacklist bypass through inconsistent normalization. The latter two also explicitly report casing variants bypassing existing-attendee checks, so the merged comment must preserve both defects.
